scope: su/main/datuming part 1 of 1; inventory incomplete: the four Kirchhoff entries lack parameter inventories and validated test pipelines, and no test pipelines were validated for sudatumfd.

programs.name: sudatumfd
programs.purpose: Apply finite-difference wave-equation datuming to two-dimensional zero-offset seismic data.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDATUMFD - 2D zero-offset Finite Difference acoustic wave-equation

params.name: nt
params.description: Number of time samples allocated per trace; replaced by each input trace's ns header.

params.name: nx
params.description: Number of receivers per shot gather.

params.name: v
params.description: Initial velocity argument; continuation routines overwrite it with model values.

params.name: x_0
params.description: Leftmost velocity-model coordinate; required despite the selfdoc's stated default.

params.name: buff
params.description: Number of padding traces on each side; required despite the selfdoc's stated default.

params.name: tap_len
params.description: Taper length in traces; required despite the selfdoc's stated default.

params.name: vfile1
params.description: Binary float velocity model for the thin-lens term, arranged v[ix][iz].

params.name: vfile2
params.description: Binary float velocity model for the diffraction term, arranged v[ix][iz].

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: from each trace header dt divided by 1000000; 0.004 if header dt is zero

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: from each trace header d2; 1.0 if header d2 is zero

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT results, trigonometric thin-lens and taper factors, complex division, and ordered tridiagonal recurrence affect reproducibility. Input ns replaces the allocation size after allocation; extra traces can overrun the shot dimension, nz=0 leaves the continued array uninitialized, and velocity-file reads and indexes are unchecked. Output headers otherwise reuse the last input trace header.
programs.difficulty_reason: It performs FFT-based wave-equation continuation with a complex finite-difference solve and multi-trace state.

programs.name: sudatumk2dr
programs.purpose: Datum receivers in two-dimensional prestack data using a Kirchhoff extrapolation operator.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDATUMK2DR - Kirchhoff datuming of receivers for 2D prestack data
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Kirchhoff summation, travel-time and surface interpolation, FFT filtering, transcendental functions, and float accumulation order affect reproducibility. Input and output streams are explicitly seek-checked, so ordinary pipes may fail.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines prestack Kirchhoff extrapolation, surface interpolation, FFT filtering, and multi-trace accumulation.
programs.license_note: Based on sukzmig2d.c by Zhenyue Liu; adapts subroutines from Dave Hale's modeling library for cubic-spline topography.

programs.name: sudatumk2ds
programs.purpose: Datum sources in two-dimensional prestack data using a Kirchhoff extrapolation operator.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDATUMK2DS - Kirchhoff datuming of sources for 2D prestack data
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Kirchhoff summation, travel-time and surface interpolation, FFT filtering, transcendental functions, and float accumulation order affect reproducibility. The input stream is explicitly seek-checked.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines prestack Kirchhoff extrapolation, surface interpolation, FFT filtering, and multi-trace accumulation.
programs.license_note: Based on sukzmig2d.c by Zhenyue Liu; adapts subroutines from Dave Hale's modeling library for cubic-spline topography.

programs.name: sukdmdcr
programs.purpose: Datum receivers in common-source prestack data using a constant-background 2.5D data-mapping formula.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKDMDCR - 2.5D datuming of receivers for prestack, common source
programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT filtering, interpolated travel times, stationary-phase geometry, square roots, trigonometric functions, and ordered amplitude accumulation affect reproducibility. The selfdoc calls the input and output parameters infile and outfile, but the code reads datain and dataout.
programs.difficulty_reason: It implements prestack stationary-phase data mapping with FFT filtering and multi-trace accumulation.
programs.license_note: Describes an adaptation of Bleistein and Jaramillo's 2.5D data-mapping formula.
